summary: PNC has filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for an offering of senior notes, including fixed-to-floating rate notes due 2030 and 2037, and floating rate notes due 2030. The proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. The filing is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No special-situation event is signalled. Note terms are incomplete (placeholders for rates and principal).
